Plumbers and Pipefitters — Journeyman Rough-In and Test Block

UA Local 38 apprenticeship

UA plumbers and pipefitters apprenticeship standards, tested against NFPA 99, NFPA 13, NFPA 25, NFPA 54, ASME B31.9, the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and the Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC) across eight distinct union jobs

Eight jobs a UA plumber or pipefitter actually rotates through: medical gas brazed under a nitrogen purge, a hydronic loop off a locked-out boiler hydrotested before cover-up, a sewer lateral trenched and shored to a proven fall, a sprinkler riser's annual flow test, a rough-in run both pressed and soldered, a failed steam trap replaced on a vented line, a water heater strapped and relief-valved to its own rating, and a new gas line air-tested and purged before anything is lit. Every station ends on a proof — a gauge, a witness mark, a signed report — rather than on how the joint looked going together.

Every level reaches 75 lessons. A lesson is one station step run under one condition; each level's number is its tasks' steps added up from the station modules.

The ladder

Level 1 is open; each level opens when the one below is passed — every task in one run of it a mastery run. A task opens its station with its condition; the number after each task is its steps.

Building Systems & Facilities

Medical Gas Brazing & Purge

13 steps · 4 hazards · 2 interruptions · par 4.3 min · indoors

The zone valve is locked and tagged before any pipe opens, the nitrogen purge runs before the torch ever lights, and every outlet is cross-tested against its own gas before the zone goes back to the floor.

  • ASSE — ASSE 6010 — Professional Qualifications Standard for Medical Gas Systems Installers
  • ASSE — ASSE 6015 — Professional Qualifications Standard for Medical Gas Systems Verifiers
  • NFPA — NFPA 99 — Health Care Facilities Code
  • OSHA — 29 CFR 1910.252 — Welding, cutting and brazing, general requirements
  • union — UA — United Association plumber, pipefitter and HVAC service apprenticeship standards and UA Star certification

Hydronic Boiler Piping & Hydrotest

13 steps · 4 hazards · 2 interruptions · par 4.5 min · indoors

  • Cal/OSHA — 8 CCR 3203 — Injury and Illness Prevention Program
  • OSHA — 29 CFR 1910.147 — The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout)

Underground Sewer Lateral & Trench Shoring

14 steps · 4 hazards · 2 interruptions · par 4.6 min

The protective system goes into the excavation before anyone works below grade, the lateral is laid to a fall checked against a laser at every joint, and the shield comes out a lift at a time as the backfill takes over holding the wall.

  • OSHA — OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P Excavations
  • union — UA — United Association plumber, pipefitter and HVAC service apprenticeship standards and UA Star certification

Building Systems & Facilities

Steam Trap & Condensate Line Repair

14 steps · 4 hazards · 2 interruptions · par 4.4 min · indoors

The failed trap's line is vented and proven at zero before the body ever opens, the replacement is matched to the application, and the line is warmed back up slowly enough that trapped condensate boils off instead of hammering through the pipe.

  • Cal/OSHA — 8 CCR 3203 — Injury and Illness Prevention Program
  • OSHA — 29 CFR 1910.132 — Personal protective equipment, general requirements
  • OSHA — 29 CFR 1910.147 — The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout)

Natural Gas Pressure Test & Leak Check

14 steps · 4 hazards · 2 interruptions · par 4.5 min · indoors

The new run is pressure-tested with air rather than fuel, every joint is soap-checked rather than trusted to the gauge alone, and the line is purged outdoors before any appliance ever sees live gas.

  • OSHA — 29 CFR 1910.147 — The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout)

What it proves

Competency: Rough in, test and prove eight distinct UA plumbing and pipefitting jobs

Demonstrated with a mastery run on 4 of its 8 stations, against ASME B31.9 Building Services Piping; IAPMO Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC); NFPA 13 Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems; NFPA 25 Standard for the Inspection, Testing, and Maintenance of Water-Based Fire Protection Systems; NFPA 54 National Fuel Gas Code; NFPA 99 Health Care Facilities Code; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout).

Badges

Each passed level earns an Open Badges 2.0 assertion naming the level, its tasks and their conditions, its lessons and the standards it evidences, with the attempts behind it as evidence, and sends an xAPI statement. Passing level 20, the capstone, climbs the whole track.

A run demonstrates mastery when it earns two or more stars, records zero unsafe actions, answers every interruption it was given, and finishes within 1.5 times the station's par time. One mastery run on enough of a competency's stations earns "demonstrated"; mastery runs on three different days earn "consistent". No other rule earns a competency.

Certification the work leads to: UA plumbers and pipefitters apprenticeship standards, tested against NFPA 99, NFPA 13, NFPA 25, NFPA 54, ASME B31.9, the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and the Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC) across eight distinct union jobs. No level claims apprenticeship hours: no registry entry states an equivalence.

Generated from the programme's station modules: lesson counts are read, not typed. The rules are in tools/briefs/ladder-brief.md and the full table in docs/ladders.md.
